description: Sparkgeo shared Renovate preset (issue #86, SecOps plan Steps 3 and 7). Consuming repositories opt in with a renovate.json that extends github>sparkgeo/github-actions. Renovate owns every ecosystem except github-actions, which Dependabot owns (#87); the release cooldown is 5 days with a security-fix exemption (sparkgeo/systeam-home#11). See docs/dependency-management.md.

packageRules.description: Pin Docker base images by digest (plan Step 3: immutable references).
Group minor and patch updates into one PR per run to keep the review queue short.
A security fix bypasses the cooldown (the weekly review already looks at it); the vulnerabilityAlerts object above covers GitHub alerts, this rule covers OSV ones.

Lock-file maintenance, pins and rollbacks carry no release timestamp Renovate can check; the package manager's own cooldown (pnpm minimumReleaseAge, npm min-release-age, uv exclude-newer) is the guard there.
